newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia helicopter crash kills five.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia helicopter crash kills five.

text.p: A helicopter crashed outside Kuala Lumpur on Saturday killing five people, including a pregnant woman and her daughter walking along a street, police said.
The helicopter crashed in the Sri Damansara industrial area, a police spokesman said. The cause was not yet known, he said.
The spokesman said three victims were found in the wreckage. A 35-year-old woman and her five-year-old daughter, believed to be Indonesians, were killed on the gound.
The helicopter was owned by a local company, Helitrade, the police spokesman said. It was headed for Kepong from Segambut helipad in Kuala Lumpur's suburbs.
The helicopter crash was the third in the country in four months.
The chairman of the the automotive group, DRB-Hicom, Yahaya Ahmad, his wife and their pilot were killed when their private four-seater Augusta-109 helicopter crashed on March 3.
Two weeks later, two Malaysian air force Nuri helicopters crashed into thick jungle near Long Pasia, in the Borneo state of Sabah, killing 11 people.
